sloka: एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोयम् कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः ।शोकसंक्लिष्टवदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम् ॥२-१८-३९॥
transliteration: etena tvāṁ narendroyam kāruṇyena samāplutaḥ ।śokasaṁkliṣṭavadano na śaknoti nirīkṣitum ॥2-18-39॥

translations.english: This is why the king with his face tortured by tears and (his heart) overwhelmed with compassion for you, is unable to look at you.
